stages.title: Subject switched to the accurate ee package
notes: All 24 required cases, the helper and the upgrade pair move to wave19-target ee7fbd8/build90e81429079a7d50/sha b0990149; b911 is the safety upgrade baseline and 97 stays a mock-only failing control. The 651/97 historical scopes are kept as history.

stages.title: Format assertions follow the package capability
notes: The format case reads the frozen package dist/source: ee produces default workflow-snapshot/1 (13 families) and explicit formatVersion 2 (21 families, familySetVersion 2), rejects version 3 without creating the destination, and leaves the source DB unchanged. A v1-only package keeps its old measured scope instead of being called a regression. Install/restore protocols stay separate.

stages.title: Ordinary personal chain on ee
notes: Default-off suggestions, explicit opt-in, non-empty candidates, confirm/replay/reject, context/history/frozen source/reply, discussion-only mode, real health/exit and native sends 0.

stages.title: Explicit restored-personal review
notes: A package-restored personal project is refused unbound (candidates/history 403) and readable after the main review-restored CLI file is supplied (candidates/history/sources/original body 200); business POST 422, held queue unchanged, provider request count unchanged. The frozen package predates the 773 entry, so the entry is the main CLI/demo consumer over package data.

stages.title: File/source/host refusals
notes: Tampered signature, foreign restored root, public file mode, symlink, FIFO, expired/tampered payload, existing output, unknown project and unsafe path are refused without starting a readable instance. Expiry with a valid signature and foreign principal/host are listed as entry NOT_TESTED because forging them needs the probe-owned key.

stages.title: Real business data and second root
notes: Installed fixture/controlled product Work/Q&A/native_applied plus SDK/context/candidates in one store; second root recovery_readonly reads them, refuses business writes, holds the queue and does not resend. The restored-personal lane is a separate personal proof, not a fixture result relabel.

stages.title: Source/read/startup permission separation
notes: Source prepare/confirm/audit and original-token behavior remain facts, not startup permission; the review file is historical read-only consent, not a private startup grant or execution authority. B wrapper is not used as recovery evidence.

stages.title: Upgrade and bounded faults
notes: b911→ee same-schema18 and 16→18, three fault windows with status/exit/pointer/operation/data, tamper refusal and rollback keeping post-upgrade data, all on the frozen pair.

stages.title: Bounded stability and UI
notes: Concurrent readonly reads, repeated token confirmations and a service reopen return queue/counts/provider to baseline; known workbench surfaces only.

stages.title: Final same-subject verdict
notes: wave20-status.json binds the result to the final source with the mode/protocol/consumer mapping; the 651/b911 ordinary-personal scopes stay history and the personal review scope is not extrapolated to native/target/value.
